what_this_is: G31's CLASSIFICATION REGISTRY (PM ruling 3 on MES-120). Every file under conformance/data/** and docs/conformance/**/*.json, keyed by path, as hand_authored, generated or raw_evidence. G31 walks both roots and requires the walk to EQUAL this list both ways, and a file carrying `authored_by_hand: true` or `generated_by` to be classified consistently with it. Only hand_authored files are scanned for figures; all classes feed the cross-reference resolver.

why.conformance/data/etcc-attribution.json: B2b's authored source; a top-level LIST, so it can carry no marker and is registered by path (PM ruling 3 on MES-120).
why.conformance/data/etcc-boundaries.json: Hand-authored table; its `control` block alone is written by `mix conformance.sweep --record-host`. The prose is authored, so the file is.
why.conformance/data/etcc-decisions.json: AUTHORED SOURCE for docs/conformance/etcc-register.json, per its own `note`.
why.docs/conformance/client-2026-07-28.json: Census of an accepted harness run (`mix conformance.census`) — evidence, not prose anyone maintains.
why.docs/conformance/confluence/report-2026-: The FROZEN payload of what MES-58 published to Confluence. Its figures are true of Sprint 5 by definition; rewriting it to satisfy an instrument would falsify the record of what was published.
why.docs/conformance/etcc-exunit-rows.json: Captured by the MCP.Conformance.ExUnitRows formatter from a test run (B3, MES-83).
why.docs/conformance/etcc-register.json: Built by conformance/build_etcc_register.exs from conformance/data/etcc-decisions.json and the exunit rows.
why.docs/conformance/oc-axes-2026-07-28.json: Carries `generated_by` (A3, MES-68, a hand-run extraction) and is registered to agree with its marker.
why.docs/conformance/client-2026-07-28-null-: Census of a harness run — evidence.
